dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I guarantee that this investment will deliver positive returns in the future. Before the final readback, is telephone still your preferred way for us to contact you about account administration?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, please call me directly. During consultancy meetings I usually leave my phone on silent. If I miss you, leave a brief message with your name and I'll return the call when I'm free.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Noted. There's no need to discuss private account information in a voicemail. Will you be travelling soon, or should we continue using your usual contact arrangements?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: I'll be away next week for work, mostly meeting clients. My mobile will still be with me. Afternoons are generally easier, but please message first so I can find a quiet place to talk.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Okay, that suits me. I prefer keeping the paperwork separate from my work email. If there's an administrative question, a quick phone call is easier than a long email exchange.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I've noted your contact preference. Thank you for making time this morning, and have a good trip. I'll let you get back to your meeting.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
